output.subject: Your auto loan payment from August 21
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us about your auto loan payment. We have received your complaint, and we want to confirm the main points you raised.

You told us that your payment of $412.37 on August 21 was applied as a principal-only payment instead of your regular monthly payment, and that you never asked for it to be applied that way. You mentioned that, as a result, your loan is now showing as past due, you were charged a $25 late fee, and you have been receiving notices and calls. You also told us the account is showing as 30 days late on your credit report and that your score dropped 60 points just as you are trying to refinance your house.

You have asked us to apply the payment as your regular monthly payment and to remove the late fee.

We understand how stressful this must be, especially with your refinance underway, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused. A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Check the payment instructions and records for the August 21 payment of $412.37 to see how it was submitted and applied.
Decide whether to reapply the payment and reverse the $25 late fee, as the customer requested.
Customer reports a 30-day late entry on their credit report; decide whether a credit reporting correction is warranted, as they did not explicitly request one but it is clearly their main concern.
Customer says they are mid-refinance on their home, so timing matters; consider whether a faster response is possible.
Customer reports ongoing past-due notices and collection calls; decide whether these should be paused while the complaint is reviewed.
Complaint was signed ⟦NAME_1⟧; confirm this matches the account holder before sending.
